# İbrahim Halil Sezgin

> Full-Stack Developer based in Istanbul, Turkey. Building web applications, automation platforms, and APIs.

## About

İbrahim Halil Sezgin is a Full-Stack Developer specializing in end-to-end web applications, real-time automation systems, and scalable REST APIs. Currently working at Jetconnect building web applications and services with event-driven architectures, workflow automation (n8n, Apify), and modern backends with Node.js and TypeScript. Also the founder of wBox.me, a high-performance WhatsApp SaaS and API automation platform.

## Technical Skills

- **Languages:** JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, Svelte, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, .NET
- **Databases:** MongoDB, MySQL
- **DevOps:** Docker, Cloudflare, Nginx, Git, GitHub
- **Automation:** n8n, Apify, WebSocket, REST API

## Experience

- **Jetconnect** (2024–Present): Full-Stack Developer — Building web applications and services. Event-driven architectures, workflow automation, modern backends with Node.js and TypeScript.
- **wBox.me** (2023–Present): Founder — Real-time messaging, bot automation, and API integration service built with Node.js, WebSockets, and MongoDB. WhatsApp SaaS platform.
- **Freelance** (2022–2023): Full-Stack Developer — Custom web applications and API development.

## Projects

- **wBox.me** — WhatsApp SaaS platform providing real-time messaging, bot automation, and API integration for businesses. Built with Node.js, WebSockets, MongoDB. [https://wbox.me](https://wbox.me)
- **hurgazete.com** — Turkish news portal.
